title: Word captions sit on the seam on SPLIT beats, at chest height on face beats
goal:
Krish, 3 Nov 2026: "The subtitles just go straight over my face." WordCaption draws every word at centerY 1440 (tall). On a SPLIT beat his face is in the lower half, so 1440 lands on it (ve qc captions.off_face measured a face box at y 1190 to 1579 on the reference's split frames).

1. WordCaption takes the beat's layout: on SPLIT the word centre is FWP_SPLIT_SEAM_Y (on the seam, as the jackroberts reel puts it); on a face beat it stays at chest height (1440 tall, 830 wide); on a graphics-only beat (plate none) it sits at 66% of the height.
2. Export the three positions in WORD_CAPTION so scripts/velib/qc_faces.py reads them (update its word_geometry to pick by layout; keep the regex reading the renderer file).

Tests: the word's top on a SPLIT beat is seam - size*0.6; face beats unchanged; tests/ve_qc_faces_test.py extended with a SPLIT case.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. The standard is docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md; every number below is measured there from Krish's inspiration-board reels.
acceptance:
